goal: Avoid a redundant lookup round trip to the local proxy on every outbound I2P connection
Ensure unreachable I2P peers are properly recorded as connection failures rather than internal proxy errors
agreement: Approach ACK because required router versions are sufficiently old (jonatack)
Suggested adding a unit test covering direct connection and peer failure (jonatack)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it saves a local proxy round trip on each outbound I2P connection
Allows failed connection attempts to unreachable I2P peers to be recorded correctly
